subject: BUILD 1: introduce ingestNode() — one funnel that embeds every node at CREATE time (not lazy on /overlay/status)
description: Create a single ingestNode(ws, ov, key, {title, summary}) helper that performs: (1) graph node create/adopt snapshot, (2) embed title (+summary if present) and setTaskVec, (3) autowireNewTaskWholeGraph to seed weight-0 judged:false candidate edges across the whole graph, (4) markEagerJudge when edges were seeded (stamps judgingSince). This is extracted from the existing inline block in routes/overlay.js:198-218 (the _hasVec-gated embed+autowire+markEagerJudge). Make buildGraph's adopt-on-first-sight (daemon.js:1467-1469) call ingestNode for newly-seen native/file-drop tasks so they are embedded+wired+eager-marked AT BIRTH, not only when a later /overlay/status write happens (today the first such write is the in_progress claim, far too late — the D-gate is moot by then). routes/overlay.js /overlay/status keeps re-embedding ONLY on summary change (interface-text update); it no longer owns first-embed. Keep embed best-effort/null-safe (no vec -> lexical fallback, never block). status: pending.

BUILD1 done — additive ingestNode() funnel landed. Branch orch/attempt/unify-ingest-node-unify; worktree /Users/imyu/.claude/orchestrator/worktrees/62dae274979b8432/unify-ingest-node-unify. Commits: 7f146ce (daemon.js + routes/overlay.js) + 8e73bd8 (test).

WHAT: (1) New async funnel ingestNode(overlay, g, key, {title, summary}) in daemon.js right after autowireNewTaskWholeGraph: embed(taskEmbedText) -> setTaskVec -> autowireNewTaskWholeGraph -> markEagerJudge(stamps judgingSince) when edges seeded. (3) routes/overlay.js first-vec block refactored to call the shared ctx.ingestNode on !_hasVec (identical harness-lane result via one funnel); kept ONLY the summary-change re-embed (setTaskVec, no re-autowire/re-mark) for already-ingested nodes.
